doc: The host-call binding inventory for the TypeScript guest (cleat#3827). Every export in engine/imports.go is either
BOUND (the cleat-js plugin installs a __cleat_* global for it, index.ts declares and wraps it, and this file maps the
global to its ABI export name) or UNBOUND (listed here with a reason, so the gap is a checked-in decision rather than
a paragraph). tests/typescript/typescript_bindings_test.go reconciles this file with all three sources and fails on
any difference in either direction, so binding a call means removing its entry here and adding one to bound.
The mapping is written out rather than derived from a naming rule, because the rule is false: the plugin's
__cleat_set_query_state binds the export set_query_state, which is unprefixed. A rule would report that global as
binding a call that does not exist and leave the real export looking unbound.
A reason starts with 'pending:' (to be bound) or 'permanent:' (deliberately never bound, with the reason it cannot be).

unbound.cleat_poll_work: permanent: the worker's work handshake; a workflow does not run the queue.
unbound.cleat_complete: permanent: the worker's completion handshake, the pair of cleat_poll_work; not guest-reachable.
unbound.cleat_register_query_handler: permanent: deliberately unbindable from a guest (ABI). A workflow may answer query state, not register the handler.
unbound.cleat_acquire_lock: pending: a durable lock with a TTL; needs a TS API that distinguishes 'acquired' from 'not acquired' rather than throwing.
unbound.cleat_await_all_children: pending: waits for every child run id at once.
unbound.cleat_await_any_child: pending: waits for the first of several child run ids.
unbound.cleat_poll_child: pending: a non-blocking read of one child's state.
unbound.cleat_child_workflow_with_options: pending: start a child with a retry policy and other per-child options.
unbound.cleat_signal_workflow: pending: send a signal to another run.
unbound.cleat_poll_signal: pending: a non-blocking read of a pending signal.
unbound.cleat_wait_for_event: pending: wait for an engine event, distinct from a signal.
unbound.cleat_poll_update: pending: a non-blocking read of a pending update request.
unbound.cleat_complete_update: pending: answer an update request; the pair of cleat_poll_update.
unbound.cleat_register_update_handler: pending: an update handler by name, for a run that answers updates rather than polling.
unbound.cleat_run_detached: pending: start a workflow nobody waits for.
unbound.cleat_start_detached: pending: start a detached workflow and keep its run id.
unbound.cleat_send: pending: a fire-and-forget call to another workflow's handler.
unbound.cleat_schedule_invoke: pending: schedule a call for a delay.
unbound.cleat_schedule_cron: pending: a cron schedule a workflow creates at run time.
unbound.cleat_delete_cron: pending: remove a cron schedule by id.
unbound.cleat_list_crons: pending: read the cron schedules the tenant has.
unbound.cleat_continue_as_new: pending: end this run and start a fresh one with a new input.
unbound.cleat_continue_as_new_versioned: pending: the same, carrying a workflow version forward.
unbound.cleat_fetch: pending: an outbound HTTP request through the host, so it is recorded and replayable.
unbound.cleat_call_retry: pending: a call with an explicit retry policy; nine parameters, so it needs a request object in the TS API.
unbound.cleat_call_heartbeat: pending: a long call that heartbeats to prove it is alive.
unbound.cleat_json_parse: pending: the host's canonical JSON parse; cleat_json_stringify is bound, so this is its sibling.
unbound.plugin_call: pending: call a named plugin function. Unprefixed export, so its global cannot follow the __cleat_ rule.
unbound.plugin_call_streaming: pending: the streaming form of plugin_call. Unprefixed export, same caveat.
